title: State types for each oracle phase
statement: Given a finite Boolean oracle machine $M$ and a finite Boolean Turing machine $C$, assign to the source phase the states of $M$ paired with a Boolean, to the dispatch phase the oracle-dispatch states, and to the service phase the disjoint union of the sweep phases and the states of $C$ paired with a Boolean.
